clues: This city sits in the southwest of a small land of high peaks, where a river flows out of a big lake. Its zone is the French speaking part.
A cold wind from the northeast can freeze the lake side in winter. Ice storms near the lake are a plain fact of the cold months.
After the First World War, this city hosted the League of Nations. The league brought lands from all over the world to one table.
This city is a world hub for talks of peace and fair play. That rare role won it the proud name of Peace Capital for all.
The world home of the Red Cross stands in this city by the lake. Teams from the United Nations work here in great ranks as well.
